item.title: Does Alabama football have a recruiting PROBLEM? Why are Tide fans so WORRIED?!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Is Alabama football recruiting really a disaster, or is this a false alarm? The Crimson Tide are either ranked low or not at all on major services tracking which programs are attracting the best high school talent in the country, causing concern for fans and dripping some blood in the water for trolls. Matt Scalici joins Ben Flanagan to break down where Kalen DeBoer and Bama actually stand on the recruiting front and how fans should feel several months away from the early signing period.

item.title: 3 Alabama football HOT TAKES 🔥 Bama can win it ALL if they do THIS!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: What is your hottest Alabama football take? AL.com's Matt Stahl joins Ben Flanagan to share a few. We talk quarterbacks, Ryan Coleman-Williams, trap games and lists that should offend any Alabama football fan. The Tide faithful thrive on being disrespected, and a new report could mean Bama's lost its edge. With SEC Media Days right around the corner, Ben and Matt break down what lies ahead for Kalen DeBoer.
